reviews.title: Want to love it more
reviews.comment: Love these fans as they look amazing! 2 cons though, first they are louder than expected and second is the lian li software. I have to reboot it constantly to get the lights to always work.
reviews.author: Cheska Faye De Castro

reviews.title: How the mighty have fallen
reviews.comment: I really expected more from  Lain Li, all I can say is the thing cools the cpu. The LED lights on the fans lasted 2 weeks the quit. The software isn't accurate, running a Ryzen 9 - 5900x / RX 6900 XT combo , with handbrake doing a 4k transcode with the GPU active the software shows the CPU load 15% and the GPU around 2%, that isn't even in the "Ball Park". The thing commands a premium price and it no better than the less expensive brand without all the bells and whistles. If it wasn't such of a hassle to yard it back out of my enthoo case I'd stuff my AK500 Digital back on this. Had I known then about running the Ryzen curve optimizer and doing the under volt on the 5900x. Which happened to drop the cpu temp 10c, I would have never bought this thing. On the plus side... It did look really cool for about 2 weeks.
reviews.author: Bama-N-Alaska
